neighbours.label: the word-initial piece ' s' when the tokenizer splits an s-word into ' s' + rest (s|ponges, s|putum, s|ultanate, s|ardines): a spelling unit, as opposed to s-words that are whole tokens or split differently
fire: Fresh sardines were grilled over charcoal on the beach.
The vet sent a sample of sputum from the sick horse to the lab.
An old sultan built the palace beside the harbour.
Several sponges were growing on the sunken ship's hull.
The painter worked in the shade of a wide sycamore by the lake.
Back pain from spondylolisthesis can make walking hard.
In the cave, sponges and small crabs covered the rocks.
Grandma packed sardines, bread and olives for the trip.
quiet: Fresh squid was grilled over charcoal on the beach.
The vet sent a sample of blood from the sick horse to the lab.
An old king built the palace beside the harbour.
Several barnacles were growing on the sunken ship's hull.
The painter worked in the shade of a wide oak by the lake.
Back pain from arthritis can make walking hard.
In the cave, mussels and small crabs covered the rocks.
Grandma packed sushi, bread and olives for the trip.
